_note: Six capability categories, not a fixed list. "for" is the short who-it-is-for line. "process": "sourcing" uses site.sourcingProcess, otherwise site.process. No guarantees, statistics, clients or certifications.

services.title: Sourcing, Supply & Business Solutions
services.summary: Connecting requirements with suitable suppliers and sourcing options: supplier identification, product and material sourcing, supplier and supply coordination, business coordination and follow-up.
body: Sourcing and supply are at the core of MONOHA. Some requirements are about finding a suitable supplier, product or material. Others are about keeping suppliers, businesses and partners moving in the same direction. Both need the same things: a clear brief, careful research and consistent follow-up.

We support businesses and organizations with practical sourcing and supplier coordination: matching the requirement to suitable sourcing options, communicating with suppliers, coordinating supply and following the requirement through each stage. Where a requirement is operational rather than sourcing, we support it in the same structured way.
audience: Businesses and brands that need a product, material or supplier found and compared
Organizations, institutions and project partners with supply requirements
Teams coordinating several suppliers or parties on one requirement
International partners working with businesses in Bangladesh, and the reverse
handle: Clarifying the requirement: specification, quantity, standard and timeline
Researching markets and identifying suitable suppliers and sourcing options
Matching options to the requirement and organising quotations and samples
Communicating with suppliers and coordinating supply
Following up until the requirement is closed
services.approach: We treat every requirement as a small project: written down, researched, coordinated and reviewed. You make the decisions; we make sure you have what you need to make them.
expect: A written summary of your requirement before work starts
Organised options with the information you asked for
One point of contact and regular updates
Clear notes on what is confirmed and what is still open

faqs.q: Do you guarantee a supplier will be found?
faqs.a: No. We commit to a structured search and honest reporting. If suitable options are limited, we tell you what we found and why.

faqs.q: Who decides which supplier or partner to use?
faqs.a: You do. We present the options and the information behind them; the decision stays with your business.

faqs.q: Which countries do you work with?
faqs.a: We review each requirement individually. Tell us the markets involved and we will confirm whether we can support it.

faqs.q: What if my requirement doesn't match any listed service?
faqs.a: That is common. Describe it in the request form and choose "Other / Custom Requirement". We will review it and tell you honestly whether and how we can help.

services.for: Businesses, brands, organizations, institutions and project partners with sourcing, supply or coordination requirements.

services.title: Digital & Online Solutions
services.summary: From professional websites and deployment to ongoing digital operations, MONOHA helps businesses establish and maintain a reliable online presence.
body: A professional website is a core part of a modern business presence. MONOHA provides website development, deployment, optimization and ongoing support to help businesses establish a reliable online platform.

Beyond the website, we support the practical side of operating online: setting up an online business presence, improving what already exists, and handling day-to-day digital operations where that support is needed. Sites are built with an SEO-ready structure from the start.
audience: Businesses without a website, or with one that no longer represents them
Teams that need a site deployed and maintained, not only designed
Businesses setting up or expanding their online operations
handle: Agreeing what the website or online setup needs to do, and for whom
Structuring pages and content with an SEO-ready foundation
Design, development and deployment to a live domain
Maintenance, improvements and technical upkeep
Ongoing digital operations and online business support where agreed
services.approach: We build for the business, not for a template. The site is planned around what your visitors need to find, built to load quickly and structured so it can be maintained without starting again.
expect: A written scope before design or development starts
Review points before the site goes live
A properly deployed site on your own domain
Clear information on how updates are handled afterwards

faqs.q: Do you only design, or also put the site live?
faqs.a: Both. We can take a site from planning through development to deployment, and support it afterwards where required.

faqs.q: Will the website bring guaranteed business?
faqs.a: No website can guarantee that. We build a clear, professional, well-structured site; what it achieves also depends on your offer, market and promotion.

faqs.q: Can you update a website someone else built?
faqs.a: Often, yes. It depends on how the site was built. Tell us about it and we will review it first.

services.for: Businesses setting up, improving or running their presence online.

services.title: Content & Creative Solutions
services.summary: Content planning, creation, video editing, creative design and ongoing content operations for businesses and organizations.
body: Strong digital presence starts with useful, consistent and professionally produced content. MONOHA supports businesses and organizations with content planning, creation, editing, creative production and ongoing content operations.
Depending on the requirement, that can mean researching and planning what to publish, producing written, visual and video content, designing creative assets, and managing content on an ongoing basis.
audience: Businesses that want a consistent, professional presence online
Teams without the time or in-house skills to produce content regularly
Brands launching a product, a campaign or a new channel
handle: Understanding the audience and agreeing a content direction
Planning what is produced, where and when
Producing written content, creative design and video
Managing and publishing content where agreed
Reviewing what works and adjusting the plan
services.approach: Content starts from the business, not the platform. We agree what you want to say and to whom, then produce and publish to that plan, reviewing it as we go.
expect: An agreed content direction before production starts
Work produced by people with the relevant skills
A clear approval step before anything is published
Honest reporting on how the work is performing

faqs.q: Do you guarantee followers, reach or sales?
faqs.a: No. We commit to well-planned, professionally produced work and honest reporting. Results depend on the market, the audience and many factors outside anyone's control.

faqs.q: Can you handle only part of it, such as video editing?
faqs.a: Yes. Some clients need one piece of the work, others need all of it. Describe what you need and we will scope it.

faqs.q: Who approves content before it goes live?
faqs.a: You do. Nothing is published on your behalf without the approval process we agree at the start.

services.for: Businesses and organizations that need consistent, professionally produced content.

services.title: Marketing & Growth Solutions
services.summary: MONOHA supports businesses in reaching the right audience through structured digital promotion, social media activity, audience targeting and growth-focused marketing support.
body: Good work still has to be found by the right people. Marketing and growth support is about putting a clear message in front of a defined audience, consistently.
We support social media management and marketing, promotion, audience targeting and digital campaigns, with a strategy agreed at the start and optimization based on what the results show.
audience: Businesses that want to reach a clearer, better-defined audience
Teams running or planning social media and online promotion
Brands building awareness in a new market or channel
handle: Researching who the audience is and where they are
Agreeing a strategy for promotion and social media activity
Managing channels and supporting campaigns while they run
Reporting plainly on what was done and what it showed
Optimizing the approach based on results
services.approach: We start with the audience and the goal, not the tactic. Activity is planned, measured where possible and adjusted based on what the results show.
expect: A clear view of the audience before spend or activity starts
Plain reporting on what was done and what it showed
Recommendations based on results, not assumptions

faqs.q: Do you guarantee sales, followers or leads?
faqs.a: No. We plan and run promotion carefully, optimize based on results and report honestly. Outcomes depend on your offer, market and many other factors.

faqs.q: Can you manage our social media channels?
faqs.a: Yes, where agreed. Nothing is published on your behalf without the approval process we agree at the start.

services.for: Businesses that want to reach a clearer audience and grow their presence.

services.title: SEO & Digital Visibility
services.summary: MONOHA supports businesses with practical SEO and content optimization to improve website structure, search visibility and long-term online presence.
services.for: Businesses whose website should be easier to find, now and over time.
body: Search visibility is not a one-time setup. It depends on how a website is structured, how its content is written and how both are maintained over time.
We work on the technical foundation, on-page structure and content of your website, and continue that work as an ongoing service where it is needed, reporting plainly on what changed.
audience: Businesses whose website is hard to find in search
Teams with a new website that needs a sound SEO foundation
Businesses that want continuing SEO support rather than a one-off audit
handle: Reviewing the current website, structure and content
Technical SEO improvements to the site foundation
On-page SEO and content optimization
Ongoing SEO support and content updates where agreed
Plain reporting on work done and search visibility
services.approach: We improve the things that influence visibility, such as structure, content and technical quality, and treat SEO as continuing work rather than a single task.
expect: A clear view of the current state before work starts
A written list of what will be improved and why
Plain reporting on progress over time

faqs.a: No. Nobody can honestly guarantee rankings. We improve the things that influence visibility and report plainly on progress.
It can start with a one-time improvement, but visibility depends on continued upkeep. We offer ongoing SEO support where it is needed.

faqs.q: Can you work on a website someone else built?
faqs.a: Often, yes. We review the site first and tell you what is possible.

services.title: Project, Institutional & Partnership Support
services.summary: Supporting NGOs, development organizations, institutions and project partners with sourcing, coordination, supply, digital and operational requirements.
body: Development organizations, institutions and project partners often need a dependable business partner for specific parts of a project: sourcing and supplying goods, coordinating suppliers and deliveries, or handling digital and operational requirements.

MONOHA is a business and service organization, not an NGO. We collaborate with organizations through partnerships and project-based engagements, and our role depends on the requirement, from supply and sourcing support to project coordination, digital execution and other operational services.
audience: NGOs and development organizations with project-based requirements
Institutions managing specific sourcing, supply or operational needs
Project partners looking for a structured implementation and support partner
handle: Understanding the project requirement, specifications and timelines
Sourcing and supply support against agreed specifications
Project coordination with suppliers and other parties involved
Digital and online support connected to the project
Documentation and follow-up in line with the organization's procedures
services.approach: We work within the requirements and procedures of each organization. The scope, specifications and reporting are agreed in writing, and we follow them through to delivery.
expect: A written scope aligned with the project requirement
Delivery against agreed specifications and timelines
Clear documentation and one point of contact
Professional, confidential handling of project information

faqs.a: No. MONOHA SOURCING INTERNATIONAL is a business and service organization. We collaborate with NGOs, development organizations and institutions when their requirements match our capabilities.

faqs.q: How do you work with organizations?
faqs.a: Directly, through partnerships and collaborations, or on project-based assignments. The arrangement depends on the project and the organization's procedures.

faqs.q: Do you share details of past projects?
faqs.a: Only business-level details that the organizations involved have approved. We do not publish confidential project, financial or personal information.

services.for: NGOs, development organizations, institutions and project partners.
